Implement ticket TK0051:
# Add kanban column action menu with status-scoped actions

Add a per-column action menu to the dashboard kanban board where available actions are defined by each ticket status definition, and implement `archive all` as the first column-level action. `archive all` must only be available for the `done` status and must archive every ticket currently in that column.

## References

- `dashboard/src/features/board/components/kanban-board.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/board/pages/project-board.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/components/project-status-settings.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/data/api/statuses.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/data/api/types.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/data/api/mappers.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/types.ts`
- `packages/schub-api/src/features/ticket-statuses/schemas.ts`
- `packages/schub-api/src/features/ticket-statuses/ticket-statuses.test.ts`
- `packages/schub-db/src/db/schema.ts`
- `packages/schub-db/src/services/ticket-statuses.ts`

No separate product spec exists for status-defined column actions. This ticket defines the behavior.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Extend ticket status definitions to persist allowed column actions (status-scoped actions list).
- Add `archive_all` as a supported action and expose it through ticket status list/create/update APIs.
- Add status settings controls so each status can define which column actions are enabled.
- Render a column action menu in kanban column headers using the actions configured on that status.
- Implement `archive all` behavior:
- Only shown for columns whose status config includes `archive_all`.
- For the default project statuses, `done` includes `archive_all`; other statuses do not.
- Executing the action archives all tickets currently in that column.
- Update dashboard/API/DB tests for action metadata and column action behavior.
- Capture verification artifacts for UI + API behavior.
- Required docs update: add short note in project status settings docs/help text that column actions are status-configurable.

### Out of Scope

- Additional column actions beyond `archive_all`.
- Undo flows, confirmation modals, or background job processing for bulk actions.
- Non-dashboard surfaces (TUI/CLI) for invoking column-level actions.

## Implementation Notes

- Store status actions as explicit data on ticket statuses and flow it through DB service, API schema, and dashboard types/mappers.
- Keep action identifiers strict (`archive_all`) and avoid free-form strings in UI logic.
- Use existing ticket update endpoints to archive each ticket in the column; run updates in a deterministic order.
- Ensure `archive all` resolves the target `archived` status robustly and fails with a user-visible error if the project has no archived-equivalent status.
- Key files/modules to touch:
- `packages/schub-db/src/db/schema.ts`
- `packages/schub-db/src/services/projects.ts` (default status seeding)
- `packages/schub-db/src/services/ticket-statuses.ts`
- `packages/schub-db/src/services/ticket-statuses.test.ts`
- `packages/schub-api/src/features/ticket-statuses/schemas.ts`
- `packages/schub-api/src/features/ticket-statuses/ticket-statuses.test.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/types.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/data/api/types.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/data/api/mappers.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/data/api/statuses.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/projects/components/project-status-settings.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/board/components/kanban-board.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/board/pages/project-board.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/board/components/kanban-board.test.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/board/pages/project-board.test.tsx`

```ts
// Example shape carried through status APIs and dashboard types.
type TicketColumnAction = "archive_all";

type TicketStatusOption = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  // ...
  columnActions: TicketColumnAction[];
};
```

Assumptions:

- `archived` remains a valid closed ticket status in project defaults.
- Bulk archive can be implemented by sequential ticket updates without a dedicated batch endpoint.

## Documentation

Update dashboard status-settings copy to explain that status-defined column actions control kanban column menus and that `archive all` is intended for done-like statuses.

## Steps

- [ ] Red - Add/expand failing tests in:
- `packages/schub-db/src/services/ticket-statuses.test.ts`
- `packages/schub-api/src/features/ticket-statuses/ticket-statuses.test.ts`
- `dashboard/src/features/board/components/kanban-board.test.tsx`
- `dashboard/src/features/board/pages/project-board.test.tsx`
- [ ] Green - Implement status-scoped column actions, add `archive_all`, and wire kanban column action menu + execution.
- [ ] Refactor - Remove duplicated status-action plumbing and keep column action handling centralized.
- [ ] Docs - Update status-settings guidance text and API examples where status payload fields are documented.
- [ ] Validation - Run required commands and collect logs, curl responses, and UI proof artifacts.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Ticket status API list/create/update payloads include column actions, and tests cover validation + persistence:
- [ ] `bun run --cwd packages/schub-db test src/services/ticket-statuses.test.ts`
- [ ] `bun run --cwd packages/schub-api test src/features/ticket-statuses/ticket-statuses.test.ts`
- [ ] Kanban board renders a column action menu and only shows `archive all` for statuses configured with `archive_all`:
- [ ] `bun run --cwd dashboard test src/features/board/components/kanban-board.test.tsx`
- [ ] Executing `archive all` from a `done` column archives every ticket in that column and no tickets outside it:
- [ ] `bun run --cwd dashboard test src/features/board/pages/project-board.test.tsx`
- [ ] API behavior is reproducible with curl and attached response artifacts:
- [ ] `curl` status list/create/update responses include status action fields.
- [ ] `curl` ticket list before/after archive-all execution shows done-column tickets moved to archived.
- [ ] Required repository validation commands pass:
- [ ] `bun run format`
- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] Storybook build succeeds for dashboard UI surfaces touched:
- [ ] `bun run --cwd dashboard build-storybook`
